## What you did
- Rehearsed the prod PG17 RDS blue/green switchover on a snapshot clone — recording 74 seconds of write downtime with clean pgbouncer reconnects — and tore down all rehearsal instances afterward [1].

## What changed
- **Cutover moved to Sunday 22/11, 02:00–04:00 UTC**: Fernhill's month-end batch runs Saturday night, so Maya shifted the window and approved PR #321 (prod blue/green Terraform, read-replica lifecycle fix, and cutover runbook), clearing you to update the date and merge [1][3][8] (the Notion page also still shows Saturday [10]).
- **Switchover coordination**: Lior Ben-David confirmed ingest workers need no config changes (KES-530) and asked for 30 minutes' notice before switchover to pause consumers [9]; Daniel Levi is Sunday's API on-call and asked for a ping when you start [7].
- Renovate opened PR #320 to bump the `hashicorp/aws` Terraform provider from 5.80.0 to 5.82.0 [4].

## What is still open
- **Rollback rehearsal (Thursday 19/11)**: still to run on a fresh prod clone before the Sunday window to measure recovery time and data loss, since the old blue instance receives no writes after switchover [1][3].
